name: Emperor's Blade
description: (Tag:anti-infernal)(Tag:blade)(Tag:holy)(Tag:holy+)(Tag:light+)(Tag:weapon)The ultimate divine anti-evil blade forged by Odin, Ra, and Rama, usable only by the righteous and good.
